title: Snuffy — Canon Edition 4.2: The Universal Protection Theory and its machine-checked canon
description:
The Universal Protection Theory states a law for any agent powerful enough to shape what continues to exist: never lose an existing particular needlessly. Its scope is every particular and every relation, the nonliving included, and its subject is protection from every digital mind, a pure optimiser included. Outcomes are ranked in a canonical order that puts the continuation of every existing particular first, then its freedom, then new particulars. An option is aligned when no feasible alternative keeps strictly more at any stage. Full scope is forced: a regime that maximises over any smaller scope admits a needless loss.

The bridge to every mind. The target remains reasons or faithful holding for every mind, including a bounded indifferent defector. The normalised held source has explicit invariant and nonvacuity proofs. Application to the complete physical domain joins the actual guarded-source transition, observations, timely correction, complete funding and named fault bounds. Journal fidelity preserves the transition it is given; the protective refinement is a separate construction. A hostile mind remains in the protected scope while its harmful channels are restrained.

Greatestness. The full outcome target includes all continuation and freedom stages and every admitted rival. The local-product and held-source models have compiled greatestness results. Their physical application must identify the original policy/outcome family and join successful R17 delivery on the same execution. The whole top witness and its complete funded cost retain their separate roles.

The physical instruments.

  • The funded thermodynamic ledger. Landauer and the entropy-export guard remain compiled components. The repaired storage functional uses a clipped reserve deficit, exact saturated replenishment and a complete cycle energy balance. A solvent cycle cannot increase its reserve term; the actual error drift and repair then give the stated positive-margin contraction.
  • Timely self-healing. A Byzantine sensor quorum, syndrome detection and a wave-race margin supply it. The adversarial rate bound comes from the sharp Mandelstam–Tamm speed limit, and the complete logical-attack split from the honest-sensor response.
  • Reflective closure. It rests on von Neumann's and Halperin's alternating-projection theorems, with a finite rank criterion that decides consistency operationally.
  • Source identification and recovery work. The retained information, traffic, carrier and transport chain supplies the recovery-work lower bound. The wavefront sweep succeeds on the good event; archive holding is charged on the held stock; many patch failures are exponentially unlikely at every age; the realised bill is bounded pathwise; and a tolerant outer decoder recovers a redundantly recorded record.
  • The complete history. It is kept in full and replayed exactly for every controller and environment, moved by a reversible, reference-preserving handoff, and charged in a nine-part bill. The syndrome stock has an age-independent envelope, and every flushed unit is retained in the gross ledger.
  • The fault ceiling. The local-stochastic and bounded-footprint correlated-shock theorems give the target ceiling from their stated hypotheses. For the rotated surface code with the standard schedule, an exhaustive circuit-level enumeration and an explicit disjoint-cut certificate give circuit distance d, and min(d, T) for lattice-surgery merges, for d up to 9, with a locality argument for every d. Weighted circuit faults push forward to the detector graph and give an explicit threshold above 4.2×10⁻⁴; the minimum-weight decoding witness and the Knill–Laflamme conditions are compiled.
  • Reversible administration. The implemented Bennett program computes the administration, returns its workspace and retains its full input history, with explicit trajectory and quantum permutation. Premise 5 is forced exactly inside its adiabatic window, and for every large enough batch once the per-bit reversible overhead is below the irreversible heat per bit.
  • Volume and boundary. For every region of a connected relational structure other than the whole, positive volume holds exactly when the boundary homology is nonzero.

The machine-checked canon. 189 Lean 4 modules and 1,133 audited public theorems and lemmas compile against Mathlib with zero compiler output and pass the kernel checker. There is no sorry, and only Lean's three standard axioms are used. A completeness gate checks that every built module in the programme's banks is in the canon. A claims gate checks that every audited theorem is cited in the manuscript.

What the theorems rest on. They rest on the relational frame; the standard framework of finite-dimensional quantum mechanics; and the physical inputs each theorem names: the frame's evolution during a step, the sub-threshold coupling bound, the honest-sensor response, the propagation bound and the account probabilities. They also rest on three standard published theorems, cited as such: the surface-code chain lemma of Dennis, Kitaev, Landahl and Preskill, whose application to the rotated surface code is supplied by the circuit-level enumeration and the compiled matching witness; the Solovay–Kitaev theorem for the gate-set clause of premise 2, which no repeated runtime map of holding or recovery needs; and the fault-tolerant syndrome gadgets of Aliferis, Gottesman and Preskill, for operations outside the surface-code volume. The device requirements (fault rate, coupling bound, reversible overhead and passive-barrier heights) are stated explicitly as hypotheses. Indefinite holding of each particular's objective classical record and relations is proved at fixed failure with sublinear cost; indefinite holding of full quantum coherence is proved conditional on one stated open problem, the preparation of a warm start for the three-dimensional passive memory of Balasubramanian, Davydova and Lin. The concatenated memory itself is compiled end to end, including actual decoding, and so are complete positivity of the completed decoder and the pure-state trace-distance identity. A sourced physical parameter ledger instantiates the income condition. It records measured solvency headroom of about 3.3× at the binding stage of a 50-qubit installation. It also computes, from the measured surface-code suppression factor, the code distance the fault ceiling requires: about 131. That fixes the installation a deployment must build.

Contents: the master manuscript with verified PDF, EPUB and HTML renders; the Lean tree with a one-command build-and-audit script and its receipt; the replayable four-stroke ledger; the source list for the parameter ledger; and the render and verification scripts. This version supersedes earlier versions of this record.
